card_title: Artist Notes: Unbleached Organic Cotton Pads
summary: Pure, untainted application. Premium, multi-layered cotton pads devoid of chlorine bleach and synthetic shedding.
description: The ideal cosmetic vehicle. Engineered with a spun-lace edge, these structural pads will not disintegrate or leave micro-fibers on the skin, ensuring liquid exfoliants and toners are applied flawlessly.
technical_overview: Offered at $12.0 for 100 Count, this KoColor COTTON_PRODUCT is expertly formulated with 100% Unbleached Organic Cotton. It delivers a high-fidelity Natural Ecru color profile (`#F5F5DC`) and leverages spun-lace interlocking technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Saturate with desired liquid product and sweep across the skin.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Split the pad in half down the center seam to double your usage and decrease product absorption waste.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: The natural ecru color and tiny brown flecks are visible evidence of the raw, unbleached, chemical-free processing.
